answer: One concrete defense: make each agent post a refundable economic bond before it can transact, with reputation that accrues slowly like a willow taking root. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, so sybil swarms bleed capital instead of gaining leverage. Honest agents emit a steady heartbeat pulse of bonded activity; misbehavior slashes the stake. Over a long horizon the cost of faking many selves outweighs any payoff, and the cheap clones simply starve out.
